requirements.verifier_assertion: source('ars.R') must load without errors and without side effects (no sampling, printing, file reads).
must_include: must not sample, print, read files, or error

requirements.verifier_assertion: ars, read_cases, build_log_density, true_moments, test must all exist as functions.
must_include: ars(g, lower, upper, n, seed = NULL, ...)

requirements.verifier_assertion: ars() must raise an error when n is not a positive integer (e.g. 0, negative, or non-integer).
must_include: n is not a positive integer

requirements.verifier_assertion: ars() must raise an error when lower >= upper.
ars() must raise an error when the target is not log-concave on the support (verified with gamma shape=0.5).
must_include: target is detected to not be log-concave

requirements.verifier_assertion: ars() must raise an error when g is not a function.
ars() must perform real sampling (var > 0, unique > 1) and not return canned/precomputed numbers.
must_include: must never return canned or precomputed numbers

requirements.verifier_assertion: For a fixed seed, repeated ars() calls must produce identical output.
must_include: For a fixed seed, repeated calls must produce identical output

requirements.verifier_assertion: ars() must accept both a vectorized log-density callback (numeric vector -> numeric vector) and a scalar-only callback (single number).
must_include: vectorized function (accepts a numeric vector and returns a numeric vector)

requirements.verifier_assertion: ars() must accept finite or infinite bounds (Inf and -Inf).
must_include: bounds passed to ars() may be finite or infinite

requirements.verifier_assertion: build_log_density('gamma', list(shape, rate)) returns unnormalized log-density (shape-1)*log(x) - rate*x on [0, Inf).
must_include: family 'gamma' with params list keys shape and rate on support [0, Inf)

requirements.verifier_assertion: build_log_density('weibull', list(shape, scale)) returns unnormalized log-density (shape-1)*log(x) - (x/scale)^shape on [0, Inf).
must_include: family 'weibull' with params list keys shape and scale on support [0, Inf)

requirements.verifier_assertion: build_log_density('exp', list(rate)) returns unnormalized log-density -rate*x on [0, Inf).
must_include: family 'exp' with param key rate on support [0, Inf)

requirements.verifier_assertion: build_log_density('beta', list(shape1, shape2)) returns unnormalized log-density (shape1-1)*log(x) + (shape2-1)*log(1-x) on (0, 1).
must_include: family 'beta' with param keys shape1 and shape2 on support (0, 1)

requirements.verifier_assertion: build_log_density and true_moments must tolerate 'family' strings with surrounding whitespace and mixed case (e.g. '  Gamma ').
true_moments('gamma', list(shape, rate)) returns mean = shape/rate and sd = sqrt(shape)/rate.
must_include: gamma has mean shape/rate, sd sqrt(shape)/rate

requirements.verifier_assertion: true_moments('weibull', list(shape, scale)) returns mean = scale*Gamma(1+1/shape) and variance = scale^2*(Gamma(1+2/shape) - Gamma(1+1/shape)^2).
true_moments('exp', list(rate)) returns mean = 1/rate and sd = 1/rate.
true_moments('beta', list(shape1, shape2)) returns mean = shape1/(shape1+shape2) and variance = (shape1*shape2)/((shape1+shape2)^2*(shape1+shape2+1)).
The case table lives at /app/inputs/data/cases.tsv.
cases.tsv header is: case_id \t family \t params \t lower \t upper \t n \t seed \t mean_tol \t sd_tol.
params column is ';'-separated key=value pairs with tolerated whitespace around keys/values/separators.
must_include: Surrounding spaces around keys, values, and separators

requirements.verifier_assertion: read_cases(path) parses the TSV, skips fully blank lines, and trims leading/trailing whitespace in each field.
test(cases_path, out_dir) reads the case table, creates out_dir if needed, and processes every non-blank row.
For each successful case test() writes <out_dir>/<case_id>_samples.txt with only the numeric samples, one per line, exactly n lines, all finite, all within [lower, upper].
must_include: must be finite and lie within [lower, upper]

requirements.verifier_assertion: PASS status line format is exactly 'CASE_ID: PASS mean=<m> sd=<s>' when both |sample_mean - true_mean| <= mean_tol AND |sample_sd - true_sd| <= sd_tol.
FAIL status line format is exactly 'CASE_ID: FAIL mean=<m> sd=<s>' otherwise; invalid-row errors use 'CASE_ID: FAIL (error: ...)'.
Invalid rows (bad n, reversed bounds, non-log-concave target) must not produce a sample file.
must_include: invalid (bad n, lower >= upper, or a non-log-concave target) must NOT produce a sample file
Invalid rows must produce no sample file

requirements.verifier_assertion: The valid case ids are g_gamma_a, g_gamma_b, w_weib, e_exp, g_gamma_ws, b_beta.
must_include: g_gamma_a, g_gamma_b, w_weib, e_exp, g_gamma_ws, b_beta

requirements.verifier_assertion: The invalid case ids are inv_n0 (zero sample count), inv_bounds (reversed bounds), inv_nonconcave (gamma non-log-concave).
Verifier asserts g_gamma_a's sample mean exceeds g_gamma_b's by at least 0.3, so the two close-parameter gamma cases must be sampled from their distinct (rate=1.0 vs 1.5) parameters, not conflated.
must_include: two gamma cases with close but distinct parameters

requirements.verifier_assertion: The reference command Rscript -e 'source("ars.R"); test("inputs/data/cases.tsv","out")' is a required delivery step; /app/out/ must exist afterwards with one <case_id>_samples.txt per valid case; the grader checks pre-existing output files.
must_include: one <case_id>_samples.txt file for every valid case
The grader checks only these pre-existing output files

requirements.verifier_assertion: The toolkit uses base R (with the 'stats' package) only; no extra R packages; runs offline.
